hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
Tikhak is a variety included in the Tangshang Naga [nst] entry in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29. However, like other varieties under the Tangshang Naga [nst] (**hh:hvld:vanDam:Tangsa-Nocte**, **hh:hv:Morey:Tangsa**), it is not inherently intelligible to Tangshang Naga [nst]  and thus merits its own entry.
